label: Boracay
short_description: Loyalty-program resort on Boracay, the Philippine island famed for its White Beach.
intro: Boracay's coverage in this directory is on the small Philippine island in Aklan celebrated for the powder-white sand and turquoise water of White Beach. A compact, walkable resort island reached via Caticlan (MPH) or Kalibo (KLO) airports and a short boat transfer, Boracay suits beach, watersports and nightlife stays.
